title: Last Cast Bass Charters

services.name: Group Fishing Charters
services.desc: Nestled between the Green Mountains of Vermont and the Adirondacks of New York, Lake Champlain is more than just a stunning body of water - it’s one of North America’s most exciting freshwater fisheries. Anglers from across the country come to test their skills against feisty bass, admire pristine island landscapes, and make memories that last a lifetime. And for many, the best way to experience this incredible fishery is by booking a charter with Captain Dave Morrissette of Last Cast Bass. Captain Dave’s story begins like that of many anglers - curiosity sparked by early experiences on the water that turn into a lifelong love.
